label: Yahoo! Shopping (JP)
terms_note: Yahoo! Shopping store (ストアクリエイターPro) with a Business ID; developer app (Client ID) registered on Yahoo! Developer Network; store-API usage application reviewed in ~1–2 weeks; caller IPs must be global and listed individually (no ranges) — platform egress must be static; tokens 12 h (4 weeks with public-key auth); ~1 request / s soft limit; one test store per Yahoo! JAPAN ID.

discovery.auth: oauth2 (Yahoo! JAPAN ID連携 / YConnect v2 with the store's Business ID-linked account; Client ID from the Developer Network; access token 12 h, refresh extended to 4 weeks with a registered public key)

auth: 1. Register a production application on Yahoo! Developer Network → Client ID (+ secret).
2. Submit the Shopping API usage application (Client ID + store account) → approved in ~1–2 weeks; list caller IPs.
3. Link the Yahoo! JAPAN ID to the store's Business ID in Store Creator Pro; optionally register a public key to extend refresh validity to 4 weeks.
4. YConnect v2 authorisation with the store account → access token (12 h) + refresh.

endpoints.purpose: create / update item, then publish (反映) reservation
endpoints.notes: item_code, name, price, description, images, options

endpoints.call: 定期購入 (subscription) APIs · 問い合わせ管理 (inquiry) APIs

reference.limits: Soft: repeated rapid access to identical URLs is blocked temporarily (~1 query / second). - Store-API usage application with review; caller IP allow-list (individual global IPs). - Developer Network terms; store account consent.
mcp_sdk: none official found in the pages opened

fields.name: client_id
fields.help: Yahoo! JAPAN Client ID (アプリケーションID) of an app approved for the Shopping store APIs, linked to the store's Business ID.

fields.name: client_secret
fields.help: The app's シークレット (sent as HTTP Basic to the YConnect v2 token endpoint).

fields.name: refresh_token
fields.help: YConnect v2 refresh token from one authorization-code consent by the store's Yahoo! JAPAN ID (https://developer.yahoo.co.jp/webapi/shopping/help/#accesstoken). It lasts 4 weeks; re-consent afterwards.

config_fields.name: seller_id
config_fields.help: ストアアカウント (store account id, lower-case letters, digits, - and _).

adapter.terms: Yahoo!ショッピング store APIs (circus.shopping.yahooapis.jp) with YConnect v2 access tokens minted from the refresh token (access token 1 h, refresh token 4 weeks). Answers are XML. Item edits (updateItems) are staged in the store editor and go live only after 全反映予約 (reservePublish or ストアクリエイターPro); stock updates (setStock) apply directly. Order APIs are deliberately not mapped: without public-key authentication any call to them shortens the refresh token to 12 hours for every API. Limit: 1 query/second per URL.

me.note: No account endpoint; the probe lists the store's top-level store categories (ストアカテゴリ一覧API) to verify the token and seller_id.

set_inventory.note: 在庫更新API: sets the stock of one item. `sku` is the 商品コード, or 商品コード:個別商品コード for a variant (e.g. item-01:sub-01); the quantity replaces the current stock. Applies immediately (no publish step). If Yahoo answers 207 the item carries an error_code (e.g. st-02104) and was NOT updated — check error_code.

update_listing.note: 商品一括更新API for one item (listing_id = 商品コード): sets 通常販売価格 (price, whole yen, required). The docs require price and sale_price together, so sale_price is sent empty — this REMOVES any 特価 on the item. The change is staged: status is OK/NG (per-field errors under raw.Result) and it goes live only after 全反映予約 (reservePublish / ストアクリエイターPro). Title/description are not changed here; stock is set_inventory.

end_listing.note: Sets ページ公開 display=0 (非公開) for one item via 商品一括更新API; reversible (display=1) and not a deletion. Staged until the next 全反映予約 (reservePublish / ストアクリエイターPro). status is OK or NG.

not_offered.create_listing: 商品登録API (https://developer.yahoo.co.jp/webapi/shopping/editItem.html) overwrites every omitted field with defaults and needs path (store category), product_category and the item's full data; images go through a separate upload API and the item must then be published with 全反映予約API. The vocabulary cannot supply the required fields.
not_offered.list_orders: 注文検索API (POST /ShoppingWebService/V1/orderList, XML <Req><Search>…, https://developer.yahoo.co.jp/webapi/shopping/orderList.html) is one of the APIs for which, without public-key authentication, "リフレッシュトークンの有効期限は「12時間」に制限されます" (https://developer.yahoo.co.jp/webapi/shopping/help/#aboutapipublickey) — one call would shorten the token for every tool. Public-key authentication needs an X-sws-signature header = Base64(RSA-PKCS1 ENCRYPTION of "sellerId:unixtime" with the store's public key), which the runtime cannot compute (it signs, it does not RSA-encrypt).
not_offered.mark_shipped: 出荷ステータス変更API (https://developer.yahoo.co.jp/webapi/shopping/orderShipStatusChange.html) is an order API: the same 12-hour refresh-token restriction applies unless each call carries the RSA-encrypted X-sws-signature header, which the runtime cannot produce.

evidence: host circus.shopping.yahooapis.jp: DNS ok, TLSv1.3 (Cybertrust Japan Co., Ltd.)
probe: 4/4 tools answered on their documented path with an auth refusal, a validation error or data; control route -> 404 (not_found), so the answers are path-specific
HTML docs spot-check (render-doc): 4/4 tool paths found verbatim on their docs pages; every parameter and body key named on the page
